name: search_issues
description: Search and filter issues using text, workflow state, ownership, labels, creation time, sorting, result limits, and comment options.

q.description: Text to search for in issue titles and descriptions.

state.description: Current workflow state of the issue.

assignee.description: Username of the person currently assigned to the issue.

labels.description: Labels that the issue must contain.

created_after.description: Only include issues created after this timestamp. Use ISO-8601 format.

created_before.description: Only include issues created before this timestamp. Use ISO-8601 format.

sort.description: Order in which matching issues should be returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return in this response.

with_comments.description: Whether comments associated with matching issues should be included.
